author: KEXP
description: In our latest in-studio session, Seattle-based metal band Witch Ripper unleash a thundering set of rock. With host Tanner Ellison, the band deliver a live performance of “The Clock Queen” and more.
title: Witch Ripper performs "The Clock Queen" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:

Echoes And Dust 06:34

The Spiral Eye 20:45
